name: personal-gmail-mcp
description: Read and act on your personal Gmail inbox and Google Calendar from Claude. Each user runs the server locally with their own Google OAuth client; tokens never leave the machine.
long_description:
**Personal Gmail MCP** exposes a personal Gmail (consumer Google account) inbox and Google Calendar to MCP clients like Claude Desktop via the Gmail and Google Calendar APIs.

## What you get

**Email tools** (`gmail_*`):
- List labels, list recent messages (with unread filter + cursor paging), Gmail-query search
- Read full messages with decoded body (text preferred, HTML fallback)
- Mark read/unread, add/remove labels (archive via INBOX, star, etc.), trash / hard-delete, untrash
- Send new mail, reply in-thread (with optional reply-all), create drafts, send drafts later

**Calendar tools** (`gmail_calendar_*`):
- List calendars
- List events in a time range with recurring series expanded to instances
- Read full event details including attendees and recurrence
- Create (with optional Google Meet link) / update / cancel events
- Respond to meeting invites (accept / tentatively / decline)

## How it works

- **Local stdio only** — no hosted backend, no proxy. Your tokens stay in the OS keyring.
- **Loopback OAuth** — first run opens a browser to sign in (Google forbids device-code for Gmail); subsequent runs refresh silently.
- **Bring your own Google OAuth client** — create a free Desktop OAuth client in Google Cloud (~5 minutes) and publish the consent screen to production for long-lived tokens. Step-by-step guide in the repo README.
- **Scopes**: `https://mail.google.com/`, `calendar.events`, `calendar.calendarlist.readonly`, `userinfo.email`, `openid`.

## Distribution note

This `.mcpb` bundle is built for **macOS arm64** only because the OS-keyring native binary is platform-specific. Users on other platforms (Intel Mac, Windows, Linux) should install via `npx -y @jaingxyz/personal-gmail-mcp`, which fetches the right native binary at install time. See the [README](https://github.com/jaingxyz/personal-gmail-mcp#readme) for full setup.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to render calendar event times (e.g. America/Los_Angeles, America/New_York, Europe/London).
